description:
A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back.
If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired.
The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order.
The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software.
After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested.
If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Reject_Home</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Home_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Decision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[acceptable]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept_End" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="End_Customer_Accept"/>

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Calculate_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Send_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" name="Wait for customer decision">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Wait_Acceptance</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Wait_Rejection</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:receiveTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Error_Retry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeTests" name="Continue from functionality test">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Tests_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorDetected" name="Was an error detected?" default="Flow_NoError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Tests_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Error_Retry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Acceptance" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_CRS_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Hardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRepair" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_MergeTests"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Software" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRepair" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_MergeTests"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="End_CRS_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
